note.en: Authored offline construction and dismantling of an interpretive Statue of Liberty: star fort, stepped foundation, granite pedestal, iron pylon, armature and a copper skin hung plate by plate, then the tablet, crown and torch; the dismantle slider pulls the skin off its frame. A deterministic 45-second film. Simplified proportions and drapery, not a survey. Silent by design; no runtime model calls.
note.zh-CN: 原创离线的自由女神像示意模型建造与拆解：星形堡垒、阶梯式基础、花岗岩基座、铁塔骨架、支撑拉杆，再把铜皮一片片挂上，最后是书板、王冠和火炬；拆解滑块把铜皮从骨架上拉开。可确定重放的 45 秒影片。比例和衣褶经过简化，并非测绘。设计上无声音，运行时不调用模型。
